selection_policy: Retrospective full-period balanced comparison after previous data inspection. Among stockcap<=25%,detailcap<=60%,semiconductor-plus-unknown-cap<=60% targets and worst-lag return>=2*TIME Jan2-close reference, minimize absolute worst daily-close MDD; tie-break lower worst turnover. No relaxation if empty; report Pareto set.
interpretation: Full-period retrospective selection with predeclared targets. No independent holdout. If selected_index is null, no constrained rule met the2x target in every scenario.
